summary: debug can no longer display a registered secret because Display masks it at every verbosity; to inspect a real value, write it to a file with copy, since module-written files aren't masked.
questions: How do I see the decrypted value of a vault variable in ansible-core 2.22?
Why does debug show $REDACTED$ for my password?
Can I disable secret masking for one task?

answer_card.title: Viewing a masked secret
answer_card.answer_md:
`debug` with `msg` or `var` writes through `Display`, so a registered secret shows as `$REDACTED$` everywhere, at any verbosity. There's **no option to disable masking for one task**.

To check the real value, write it to a file (module-written files aren't an output boundary):

```yaml
- name: Write the secret to a file for inspection
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ db_password }}"
    dest: /tmp/db_password.txt
    mode: "0600"
  delegate_to: localhost
```

Read it outside Ansible and delete it afterwards.
